name: migros/open
description: Get Chrome onto the Migros site with the banners cleared. Does NOT search - every search navigates to its own URL from wherever it starts.

steps.note: Reuses the browser you already have; a url on this step would open a NEW TAB every run.
Just to be on the site, so cookies and any consent banner are settled. This page is the corporate hub and has NO search box - that is fine, nothing here needs one.
